limitations.quote: // The final 0 is also the start of a possible overlapping match.
limitations.note: The patch fixed the duplicate state encoding but also changed the post-match transitions: a valid 1 now goes to `s2_d01` and an invalid cycle goes to `s1_d0`, whereas the original behavior sends both to `idle`.
The exhaustive test used a rolling history that assumed overlapping matches, so it accepted the changed behavior instead of checking that the original post-match transitions were preserved.
